text.tspan: CNAME vs Alias: pointing a name at an AWS resource
• NOT at the zone apex (root, mydomain.com)
• no other record may share its name
• target must resolve (A/AAAA) · you set the TTL
• hostname → AWS resource or a record
• works at the ROOT and on subdomains
• follows the resource's IP changes itself
• no TTL to set · free queries to AWS resources
example.com A ALIAS → MyALB-123456789.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com (AWS-managed; its IPs change, the alias keeps up)
Root domain (example.com) → AWS resource: Alias (CNAME is impossible at the apex).
Subdomain → non-AWS hostname: CNAME. Subdomain → AWS resource: Alias preferred (free, auto-updates).
